module: "Tools" sub-window of the race editor (raceEditor). "Side Decorators" section: generates decorations (TSStatic .dae or prefab) on both sides of the pathnodes, with position/rotation/scale offsets and alignment mode (terrain, pathnode, absolute), colored line preview and Create / Replace / Remove buttons ("<name>_decoration" SimGroup in MissionGroup). "Pathnode Tools" section: drop all nodes to the ground, align normals to the terrain, set all radii, remove redundant BeamNGWaypoints, align to grid, delete all segments. "Debug Tools" section: open the test window and path/autoConfig dumps. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/tools')(raceEditor).
notes: Initial values: position offset (0, 0, 0.2), rotation (0, 15, 0) in degrees (converted to radians), scale (1, 1, 1), alignment mode "terrain".
Default shape for left and right: art/shapes/race/sign_checkpoint.dae.
Probable bug: "Drop All Pathnodes to Terrain Height" writes via changeFieldMulti('pos', ...) a number (terrain height) into the nodes' pos field, which is a vec3; only z should change.
Bug: setFieldsUndo iterates oldDataMap with ipairs while the keys are node IDs (sparse table); undo therefore only restores consecutive IDs starting from 1.
Bug: C:selector uses the variable "value" (undefined) and calls self:changeField which does not exist in this file; the method is not called by the module.
"Align All Pathnodes to Grid", "Remove Redundant BeamNGWaypoints" and "Remove All Segments" modify directly without going through the history (not undoable).

The left shape's mode is "unknown" and the right one's is "none" if the extension is neither dae nor prefab; in that case no decoration is created for that side (createDecoration only handles 'dae' and 'prefab').

init.desc: Stores raceEditor and initializes the decoration position, rotation and scale offsets.

setPath.desc: Sets the race path being edited.

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active; does nothing.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left; does nothing.

draw.desc: Called every frame: draws the tools UI.

createDecoration.desc: Creates a "<path name>_decoration" SimGroup (numeric suffix if the name already exists) in MissionGroup and places one object per transform in it: TSStatic for a .dae, prefab (spawnPrefab) for a .prefab / .prefab.json, depending on the side (l/r). Remembers the group as the last created group.

transforms.desc: List of transforms {side='l'|'r', pos, rot, scl} from pathnode:getSideTransforms.

existsIcon.desc: Displays a check icon if the file exists (FS:fileExists), otherwise an error icon, with a path tooltip.

changeFieldMulti.desc: Modifies the same field of several pathnodes in a single history action (old values stored for undo).

newDataMap.desc: Maps the pathnode ID to the new value.

getSideTransformParameters.desc: Returns the side decoration parameters entered in the window, to pass to pathnode:getSideTransforms.

returns.desc: Rotation offset in radians (entered degrees × π/180).
Alignment mode: terrain, pathnode or absolute.

drawGeneralInfo.desc: Draws all the content: side decorations, pathnode tools and debug tools.

displayClassification.desc: Displays a "name" line with a check or cross icon depending on classification[field].

selector.desc: Dropdown to select a path object for a field (see notes: non-functional and unused here).

objects.desc: Collection (objects, sorted) of nodes or positions.
